Looking for a bottle you can reach for every day? Watermelon Berry Cloud Nurdz Salts from Cloud Nurdz is a nicotine-salt e-liquid built around a rounded berry profile that leans fruity without feeling heavy. It is stocked and shipped from our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse.

Watermelon Berry Cloud Nurdz Salts is listed at $11.99 in our Vape Juice range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vape Juice](/shop/vape-juice/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Watermelon Berry points to a rounded berry profile that leans fruity without feeling heavy, with cool, juicy melon sweetness with a light, watery finish. Descriptions like this are a guide to the intended profile; your own experience will depend on your setup and preferences.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Cloud Nurdz
- **Category:** Vape Juice
- **Flavor:** Watermelon Berry
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $11.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Ready-to-use formula:** arrives pre-mixed, so there is nothing to blend and you can fill your device straight away.
- **Bottle sized for refilling:** the bottle is built for tidy refills and easy storage on a desk or in a bag.
- **Clearly labelled strength:** the nicotine strength is shown on the label and on this page, making it easier to compare against what you used before.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Watermelon Berry Cloud Nurdz Salts suits adult vapers with a refillable pod or tank who want to stay with a flavor they enjoy, and those comparing strengths and bottle sizes before they restock.

## Using and caring for it
Check that your device supports the type of e-liquid you buy: nicotine-salt liquids suit low-power pod systems, while freebase liquids are usually chosen for sub-ohm tanks and higher wattage. Fill slowly, wipe the tip clean, let a fresh coil soak for a few minutes before the first puff, and keep the bottle upright with the cap closed between uses. Store it away from heat and direct sunlight, and keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Watermelon Berry Cloud Nurdz Salts online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by USPS or UPS. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
